Join As You Go (JAYG) Method
item.description:
Join As You Go method allows you to crochet your granny square while simultaneously joining it to another square. Perfect if you’re not a fan of sewing your squares together or having to weave in extra ends.
INSTRUCTIONS Simply work your stitch, remove hook from the loop, insert into corresponding stitch on the other square (front to back) place loop back on hook and pull loop through the stitch to join. Repeat until all the corresponding stitches are joined
